title: Tower Multipliers ×1–×5
summary: Every reel standing fully wild during a free spin is dealt a ×1–×5 badge. A winning combination pays × the HIGHEST badge it crosses. Carries the free-spins RTP in Vice Heat.

rule.dealtTo: every reel that stands FULLY WILD during a free spin
rule.weightsMeaning: index 0 = ×1 … index 4 = ×5; relative weights, not percentages of a fixed base
rule.applyDetail: a ways combination starts on reel 0 and runs matchCount reels, so it crosses reels 0..matchCount-1; the win is multiplied by the highest badge among the expanded reels in that span
rule.notProduct: the product of crossed badges measures 187% RTP on a bought 4-scatter round
rule.notSum: the sum floors at 90.53% even with the weights pushed to the floor

sticky.detail: a 4-scatter STICKY tower keeps the badge it was dealt when it JOINED; a 3-scatter round re-expands from scratch each spin and therefore draws fresh badges each spin

randomness.why: the badge draw must not consume words from the reel-stop stream — reels must land identically with the mechanic on or off, or every certified RTP figure becomes meaningless for the implementing build

placement.why: clears the vertical WILD lettering on the tower art

lockPop.why: badge and tower must read as ONE impact; two separate fades read as no impact at all

referenceImpl.note: pure and seed-derived; shared by settlement (src/dev/mockHost.ts) and the decode façade, so display and payout are the same function of the same seed
